name: Oblivion Confinement
description: Banishes an enemy within %cast_range% tiles for %duration% turns, stunning it but leaving it invulnerable, and stealing %int_steal:pct%% of its intelligence.

upgrade.summary: Every blow this unit lands also steals %passive_int_steal:pct%% of the victim's intelligence (minimum 1).
details: Applies to all damage this unit deals - basic attacks, Sanity's Eclipse, everything - not only Oblivion Confinement's own cast.
Always steals at least 1 intelligence, even from a victim with very little left.
